notes.mae: Mean absolute error. Interpretable in target units; robust to outliers.
notes.rmse: Root mean squared error. Penalizes large errors; sensitive to outliers.
notes.mape: Mean absolute percentage error. Undefined when actuals are 0; asymmetric and can explode for near-zero actuals.
notes.smape: Symmetric MAPE. Bounded by 200%, symmetric in relative terms, but can be misleading when both values are near 0.
notes.wape: Weighted APE. Sum of absolute errors divided by sum of actuals; robust to small denominators and stable for low-volume series.
